title: Developing a European Clean Aviation Regional Ecosystem (ECARE)
description: Objective : Establish a networking platform that will facilitate the interaction between the national and regional stakeholders (including clusters); support and coordinate the national and regional activities with the Clean Aviation programme; and identify specific measures aimed at increasing the involvement of SMEs and other stakeholders in the Clean Aviation programme. For the full description of this topic please download the PDF document of the topics from the "Additional Documents" section.
